characters.name: Lady Evelyn Vance

dialogues.target: Confess to Harriet Vance-Cole [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "Fine! I put sleeping powder—chloral hydrate—in the Bordeaux decanter in the Dining & Sideboard at 7:58 PM to steal the Will! NOT Aconite! And Exhibit F proves he NEVER DRANK THE WINE! I'm a thief, not a murderer!"

characters.name: Thomas Graves

dialogues.target: Say to Thomas Graves [after Exhibit F]:
dialogues.line: "Exhibit F confirms concentrated Aconite—fatal in two to three minutes. If Arthur collapsed at 8:48 PM, it entered his system right around 8:45 PM from whatever he carried into the Study!"

characters.name: Victor Vance

I blackmailed Chef Henri Laurent to cut the lights at nine, and at 8:42 PM I handed Arthur a steel pocket flask of aged scotch laced with concentrated Aconite—he died alone at 8:48 PM. I used Dr. Julian Mercer for my 8:55 PM alibi, and only slipped up at 9:01 PM when I claimed I smelled bitter-almond wine and saw his pale lips while he was face-down! My Shadow Team allies were Chef Henri Laurent and Victor Vance."

"I rolled Arthur over at 9:01 to check his pulse—pure reflex! Don't get distracted by a half-burned 2008 page; ask Chef Henri Laurent why the lights conveniently died at nine!"
"Yes, I handed Arthur a steel pocket flask of aged scotch at 8:42 PM—completely harmless! If his watch stopped at 8:48, he must have dropped it before arguing at 8:55. Don't fall for a frame-up!"

characters.persona: Theatrical, scatterbrained ghostwriter living at the manor for two months to write Arthur's tell-all memoirs.
characters.secret: Arthur fired you yesterday for peeking at his sealed Archive Box #4 (making you look bitter!), though you are innocent of murder.
characters.clue: Two days ago, you helped Arthur record Chapter 12 of his memoirs onto a blank brass cylinder—word-for-word: 'You've gone too far! I'm calling the police as soon as the lines are back!'
characters.detention: Searched from Alistair's Notebook: Nov 17 shorthand notes: 'Recorded Arthur's Ch. 12 quote onto brass cylinder (You've gone too far! I'm calling the police!). Subject: 2008 Archive Box #4 cover-up.'
characters.accusedResponse: INNOCENT DEFENSE: "I am INNOCENT! Check Exhibit E—in 2008 I was Ghostwriter & Archivist, Vance Press (2007–2008), with zero connection to '2008 Witness Intimidation — Buried Police Report' or Archive Box #4. I had no concentrated Aconite, didn't touch the Chronos Automaton, and didn't cut the generator!"

dialogues.line: "Don't you find it extraordinary? The exact words we heard Arthur shouting at 8:55 PM—'You've gone too far! I'm calling the police as soon as the lines are back!'—are word-for-word from Chapter 12 of the memoir he dictated to me two days ago!"

dialogues.target: Say to Celeste Moreau [after Exhibit D]:
dialogues.line: "I personally helped Arthur record Chapter 12 onto a blank brass cylinder two days ago and watched him set it beside the Automaton! If that cylinder is inside Exhibit D, someone swapped it to fake his voice!"

dialogues.target: Say to Clara Sterling [after Exhibit E]:
dialogues.line: "Arthur fired me yesterday just for peeking at his sealed Archive Box #4! Chapter 12 of his memoir was all about that 2008 cover-up—and Exhibit E finally names the culprit he was protecting!"

exhibits.title: Study Crime Scene Sketch (9:02 PM)
exhibits.html:
• The Body: Lord Arthur Vance found slumped across his desk blotter. First reached and rolled over by Damien Cross at 9:01 PM.
  • Initial Statement (9:01 PM): As guests rushed in, Damien Cross loudly claimed to see Arthur's "chalk-pale lips" and smell "bitter almonds from the spilled wine."
  • Desk & Floor Notes: Unsigned New Will; untouched crystal wine glass; single poured porcelain cup of chamomile tea (barely lukewarm by 9:02 PM); broken pocket watch; shattered glass beside a 5-lb brass counterweight in spilled liquid.

exhibits.title: Arthur's Shattered Pocket Watch
exhibits.html:
• Make: Custom Vance Precision Gold Chronometer ("A.V. — Time Never Lies").
  • Condition: Crystal cracked; internal gears jammed from hitting the desk corner.
  • Frozen Time: 8:48 PM (12 minutes before the 9:00 PM blackout).
  • Witness Note: Damien Cross snapped the gold lid shut at 9:01 PM, claiming Arthur's watch "always ran twelve minutes slow."

exhibits.title: Charred Audit Log ('H.L.' / 'D.C.')
exhibits.html:
VANCE PRECISION INSTRUMENTS — CONFIDENTIAL AUDIT
ARCHIVE BOX #4 (SLATED FOR RELEASE WITH NEW WILL)
-------------------------------------------------
SUBJECT:   2008 Witness Intimidation — Buried Police Report
FINDING:   Key whistleblower silenced with threats; incident report FALSIFIED
FLAGGED INITIALS: "H.L." / "D.C." [ROLES & DATES BURNED]
NOTE:      One party falsified the 2008 record; the other had
           no clearance or access to Archive Box #4 in 2008.
STATUS:    Suppressed by A. Vance (2008). Full disclosure
           ordered upon execution of New Will.

exhibits.title: Chronos Automaton, Wax Cylinder & Study Re-Inspection
exhibits.html:
• Phonograph Drum: Plays a removable brass wax cylinder at a scheduled minute. Currently set to 8:55 PM.
  • Release Cam: Drops a 5-lb brass counterweight at 9:00 PM (shifted 2 inches to strike the water carafe).
  • Cylinder Label: Reads "9:00 PM Gala Greeting" — hastily glued over a scratched-out title: "Memoir Draft — Confrontation."
  • Study Re-Inspection (Clear Light): The crystal wine glass on the desk is completely full & untouched; the shattered glass on the floor is a water carafe in clear, odorless liquid (zero wine, zero bitter-almond scent). Desk-blotter impressions confirm Arthur collapsed face-down, facing away from the door until Damien Cross rolled him over.

exhibits.title: Crumpled Generator Note
exhibits.html:
Found crumpled on the basement stairs as guests regrouped before Act II:

"9:00 PM sharp. Pull the main breaker. Don't let anyone see you. — E.V."

exhibits.title: 2008 Dossier Ledger & Horologist Journal
exhibits.html:
• Selected 2008 Archive Records:
    • Lady Evelyn Vance: Director of Vance Charity Gala Fund (2006–2008)
    • Clara Sterling: Lead Trust Counsel, Vance Legal Holdings (2005–present)
    • Thomas Graves: Estate Steward & Keyholder, Ravenshollow (1999–present)
    • Celeste Moreau: Master Appraiser, Geneva Horology Guild (2008)
    • Chef Henri Laurent: Cleared — No clearance or access to Archive Box #4 in 2008 (unrelated to the 2008 incident).
    • Damien Cross: Private Investigator & Fixer, Cross Security (2006–2008)
  • Arthur's Horologist Journal (Nov 15): "A clockmaker whose own pocket watch loses a single second is a fraud. My gold chronometer is calibrated daily to the U.S. Naval Observatory signal. It has not drifted by half a second in eleven years."

exhibits.title: Field Toxicology Report
exhibits.html:
• Red Wine (Dining Sideboard Decanter & Untouched Study Glass): Positive for Chloral Hydrate (non-lethal sleeping sedative). Arthur never drank it.
  • Residue on Arthur's Lips & Cuff: Positive for Concentrated Aconite (fast-acting, completely odorless cardiac poison; fatal in 2–3 minutes) — matching trace contact from a steel pocket flask of aged scotch.
  • Floor Puddle: Plain spring water. Zero wine, zero bitter-almond odor.

exhibits.title: Anonymous Library Rumor
exhibits.html:
Found slipped under the Library door before Act III:

"Check the Dining & Sideboard! Someone wiped down the Bordeaux decanter left on the sideboard with an almond-scented handkerchief right before 9:00 PM."

prologue.label: PROLOGUE — 9:00 PM
prologue.sub: Read aloud (or click Read Aloud) to set the scene at Ravenshollow Manor.
prologue.html:
Welcome to Ravenshollow Manor. Outside, a violent November nor'easter has washed out the wooden bridge to the mainland, and the telephone lines are dead. You are guests of billionaire clockmaker Lord Arthur Vance (72).

At 8:45 PM, Arthur retired alone to his second-floor Study to fetch his New Will, bolting the heavy oak door from the inside. At 8:55 PM, guests in the Grand Hall heard Arthur shouting from upstairs: "You've gone too far! I'm calling the police as soon as the lines are back!"

At 9:00 PM sharp, as the Grand Astronomical Clock struck nine, the backup generator died—plunging the manor into darkness for 15 seconds. A sharp crack and heavy thud echoed from the Study. When the lights returned at 9:01 PM, you broke down the bolted door—and found Arthur Vance dead at his desk.

act1.label: ACT I — THE LOCKED STUDY (7 MIN)
act1.sub: Read Public Opener, reveal Act I Evidence, mingle (7m), then Public Vote #1 (Detain 1 + Elect Group Leader).
act1.html:
Thomas Graves (#3)
"Nobody touch a thing! The oak door was bolted from the inside, and the window drops eighty feet to the rocks. How on earth could someone kill him in a locked room?"
Dr. Julian Mercer (#4)
"He was shouting at someone at 8:55! We all heard him! Then at 9:00 the lights went out and—my God, was that a gunshot?"
Damien Cross (#14)
"There is no bullet wound. It was poison! The moment the lights came back on at 9:01, I saw Arthur's chalk-pale lips and smelled that unmistakable bitter-almond scent from the spilled wine. He died right around nine."
Thomas Graves (#3)
"Begging your pardon, but when I stepped beside the desk, I noticed Lord Arthur's pocket watch had smashed on the corner—its hands were stopped at 8:48."
Damien Cross (#14)
"Ah, yes, I closed the lid so it wouldn't upset everyone. Arthur's watch always ran twelve minutes slow—he told me so himself just yesterday."
Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)
"Slow or not, the New Will is still on his desk—unsigned. Whoever wanted Arthur dead before 9:00 PM is standing in this room."

act2.label: ACT II — SHADOWS IN THE CLOCKWORK (6 MIN)
act2.sub: Read Public Opener, reveal Act II Evidence, mingle (6m), then Public Vote #2 (Detain 1 + Group Leader's Extra Detention).
act2.html:
Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)
"While the upstairs gallery was cleared, we inspected the Study fireplace and the Chronos Automaton. We have new evidence—a half-burned 2008 audit log flagging the initials 'H.L.' and 'D.C.', and a scratched brass wax cylinder inside the Automaton."
Celeste Moreau (#7)
"Wait—a scratched cylinder? Arthur built the Chronos Automaton to play a recorded greeting at 9:00 PM. You can also program its brass counterweight to drop on the hour. If someone swapped the cylinder..."
Chef Henri Laurent (#9)
"Don't look at me just because 'H.L.' is on that burned page! Half the people in this house had a reason to hate Arthur. And if you're wondering why the lights went out at nine, the storm probably surged the old breaker!"
Lady Evelyn Vance (#1)
"Oh, spare us! And what about the wine? Damien Cross said it smelled of poison—who poured Arthur's glass?!"
Thomas Graves (#3)
"Actually... look at our Study re-inspection in the Chronos Automaton evidence. In clear light, the wine glass on the desk is completely full and untouched—it was the water carafe that shattered in odorless water, and Arthur was slumped face-down!"

act3.label: ACT III — THE LAST CHIME (7 MIN)
act3.sub: Read Public Opener, reveal Act III Evidence, mingle (7m), then Final Verdict (3m) & Reveal!
act3.html:
Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)
"Enough games. We unlocked Arthur's private Horologist Journal and the 2008 Archive Ledger—and tested the residue in the Study with a field chemistry kit."
Thomas Graves (#3)
"Look closely at the 2008 Dossier Ledger and Field Toxicology Report before you cast your final vote. The single cup of chamomile tea poured at 8:40 PM was untouched and barely lukewarm by 9:02 PM—and Arthur never touched his wine."
Damien Cross (#14)
"Careful, everyone—wild theories will only let the real killer slip away. Look at who had the motive to steal the Will, who rigged the power, and who wasn't in the Grand Hall at nine. Let's settle this."

revealHtml:
The Truth Behind the Last Chime (RV-0176)

The Killer: Damien Cross (#14)
The Accomplices (Shadow Team): Chef Henri Laurent (#9), Victor Vance (#5)
The Inspector: Harriet Vance-Cole (#8)

Arthur Vance did not die at 9:00 PM. He died at 8:48 PM—alone behind a bolted door—from concentrated Aconite hidden in the steel pocket flask of aged scotch handed to him by Damien Cross (#14) at 8:42 PM. At 9:01 PM, Damien Cross rushed to the desk first, pocketing the steel pocket flask of aged scotch and later ditching a botanical-smudged handkerchief down the upstairs laundry chute.

Lady Evelyn Vance (#1) spiked the red wine with harmless sleeping powder, which Arthur never touched. The 8:55 PM argument was a pre-recorded brass wax cylinder played by the Chronos Automaton, and the 9:00 PM crash was the counterweight smashing the water carafe while blackmailed accomplice Chef Henri Laurent (#9) cut the generator breaker for 15 seconds.

The 4-Pillar Proof: (1) Arthur's pocket watch froze at 8:48 PM and his Horologist Journal proves it never lost a second; (2) The wine was untouched and Arthur died of odorless Aconite from the steel pocket flask of aged scotch; (3) Damien Cross slipped up in Act I by claiming to see Arthur's pale lips (Arthur was face-down!) and smell bitter almonds from spilled wine (it was odorless water!); (4) Exhibit C flagged both "H.L." and "D.C.", but Exhibit E clears Chef Henri Laurent (no 2008 access) and ties Damien Cross directly to 2008 Witness Intimidation — Buried Police Report — Private Investigator & Fixer, Cross Security (2006–2008)!
